import pytest
from httpx import AsyncClient


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_create_cart_returns_201_with_user_id(client: AsyncClient):
    resp = await client.post("/api/v1/carts/", json={"user_id": 1})
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["user_id"] == 1
    assert body["status"] == "open"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_get_cart_404_when_missing(client: AsyncClient):
    resp = await client.get("/api/v1/carts/99999")
    assert resp.status_code == 404


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_create_cart_422_without_user_id(client: AsyncClient):
    resp = await client.post("/api/v1/carts/", json={})
    assert resp.status_code == 422
